decision_question: May this portable screening handoff source and its development fixtures be published in Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: Discriminate screening logistics from application submission, tracker reconciliation and substantive assessment.
Tie writes and completion to the exact screening instance.
Preserve owner consent and private data boundaries under blocked and uncertain access.
Validate package, links, license and review provenance. Label live, host and holdout coverage accurately.

sources.description: Multiple role-specific invitations, reminder follow-up, verified preliminary progress, current versus prior employment facts, consent gate, offered voice or text, blocked account access and a separate attachment correction.
Resume Representative covers preparation. Saved opportunity triage covers sourcing and ranking. Application status reconciliation covers record correction and verified employer milestones.

independence.reviewer_configuration: Separate reviewer contexts, inherited model; restricted read-only access to supplied source, reference and fixture files.
shared_model_or_source_limits: Shared model family and collaboration tool environment.
Reviewer observations are static and correlated by the same source set.
No live portal access or unseen holdout.

initial_reviews.finding: Milestones are grounded. Initial fixtures did not independently verify per-screen saves or require dated instance-level completion.
The companion scope is distinct. Exact role alone was insufficient completion evidence when more than one screening exists. Provisional and next-action records needed an explicit field.
Bind writes to the exact instance and check navigation effects, origin and mixed administrative/assessment controls. Hold uncertain writes for readback.

changes: Require exact screening identity before writes and completion; retain provisional records and unmatched receipts.
Check private link provenance, destination and side effects; leave mixed administrative and recording controls with the candidate.
Add per-instance saves, same-role mismatch, ambiguous receipt, unknown facts and separate trusted-origin mixed-control cases.

falsification_hypotheses: A same-role reissue permits a write to the wrong screening or misassigns a role-only receipt.
A combined save-and-record control passes as an administrative answer.
An uncertain write can be replayed before a readback.
test_results: Exact-instance clauses and same-role fixtures block the first counterexample.
Candidate-owned mixed-control clause addresses the second. An initially combined redirect fixture was split to isolate the trusted-origin control.
Attempted-unverified state and same-instance readback prevent the third.
disruptor.execution: Static counterexample review of the written contract and development fixture design.

decisive_evidence: Exact hashes matched final skill, reference and evaluation design.
Same-role mismatch and unassigned role-only completion are covered.
Trusted-origin mixed-control and uncertain-write cases isolate the required decisions.
unresolved_items: Live task execution, with/without comparison, unseen holdout, and installed host acceptance remain unverified.

limitations: Source publication and offline workflow design only.
Eleven development cases are designed and inspected; there are zero live runs and no usable packaged holdout.
Source publication does not authorize access, writes, consent, or participation in a candidate portal.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming live write reliability or host acceptance
follow_up.action: Run comparable external holdout and authorized host checks against the exact released version.
